chunks: Therefore, keep off from this affair,
take heed of the accounting (on the Day of Judgement),
get ready for death that will soon overtake you
and do not give your ears to those who have gone astray.
If you do not do so I shall recall to you whatever you have forgotten,
because you are a man living in ease and luxury. Satan has taken you in his clutches,
has secured his wishes in you
and has taken complete control of you like your soul and blood.

key_terms.الْحِسَابِ: Accounting/Reckoning on the Day of Judgement
key_terms.مَجْرَى: Course/Flow (like a river or bodily fluid)
key_terms.مُتْرَفٌ: One living in ease and luxury

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual warning given to Muawiya regarding Satan's influence in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this epistle to Muawiya, Imam Ali (AS) employs the metaphor of 'pacas' (darkening the eyes with sleep or neglect) to urge decisive withdrawal from political entanglements and preparation for the Hereafter. He diagnoses Muawiya’s spiritual state as one of total Satanic domination, where luxury has rendered him unconscious of his own soul, a condition reflecting the Shia critique of Umayyad materialism and its disconnect from divine accountability.
